title: Glowing headphones
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#66e0ff' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#66e0ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bandGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6ec7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c44dff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cupGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7af0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3ab8e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura behind headphones -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Headband -->
  <path d='M22 52 Q22 14 50 14 Q78 14 78 52' fill='none' stroke='#ff6ec7' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M22 52 Q22 14 50 14 Q78 14 78 52' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3e6' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Left ear cup -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='60' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#3ab8e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='60' rx='11' ry='15' fill='#7af0ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='60' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#c4f7ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='60' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Right ear cup -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='60' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#3ab8e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='60' rx='11' ry='15' fill='#7af0ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='60' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#c4f7ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='60' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Cushion highlights (lighter edge, no dark outline) -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='50' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#a0f0ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#a0f0ff' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='24' r='1.8' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='22' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='1.3' fill='#fff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='38' r='1.4' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='36' r='1.6' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- Sound wave arcs left -->
  <path d='M8 50 Q4 60 8 70' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3e6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M4 46 Q-1 60 4 74' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3e6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Sound wave arcs right -->
  <path d='M92 50 Q96 60 92 70' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3e6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M96 46 Q101 60 96 74' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3e6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
